title: HR Assistant / HR Administrator / HR Support Officer
description:
📂
**We’re Hiring: HR Assistant / HR Administrator / HR Support Officer**

**🕒 Employment Type:**
Full-Time

💼
**Level:**
Entry-Level / Mid-Level

We’re seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and people-focused HR professional to provide administrative support across human resources functions. This role is ideal for someone with strong organizational skills, a proactive attitude, and an interest in employee administration, recruitment coordination, and workplace support. The successful candidate will help ensure efficient HR operations and a positive employee experience.

📋
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Human Resources department.
* Maintain and organize employee records, personnel files, and HR documentation.
* Assist with recruitment activities, including interview scheduling and candidate communication.
* Coordinate employee onboarding, orientation, and offboarding arrangements.
* Prepare HR letters, employment documents, internal notices, and personnel forms.
* Support attendance monitoring, leave records, and employee information updates.
* Respond to general employee inquiries regarding HR procedures and company policies.
* Assist with payroll documentation, benefits administration, and employee records management.
* Ensure HR databases and administrative records remain accurate and up to date.
* Support employee engagement activities, internal events, and HR departmental projects.
* Handle confidential employee information with professionalism and discretion.

📝
**Requirements**

* Background in human resources, business administration, or office administration is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of HR administration and employee management procedures.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word and Excel.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Good written and verbal communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple administrative tasks and meet deadlines.
* Professional attitude with strong interpersonal and teamwork skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive information.
* Willingness to learn and develop within the HR field.

✨
**What We Offer**

* Opportunities to gain practical experience across HR functions.
* Exposure to recruitment, employee administration, and HR support operations.
* Professional training and career development opportunities.
* A collaborative workplace that encourages learning and teamwork.
* Opportunities for long-term professional growth.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.

title: IT Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Company description**

TradeAir (IFSC) is an IFSCA-registered broker-dealer and fund management entity in GIFT City, trading on NSE IX and India INX.

**Role description**

You will build and run our trading infrastructure and mid- and back-office systems, and act as our CISO. We want someone who understands networks, systems and financial markets, and can show what they have built.

• Build and run trading infrastructure, including exchange connectivity to NSE IX and India INX.

• Set up access to international exchanges and brokers, such as CME via its Aurora data centre.

• Run data-centre and colocation environments, and design the network and server room for our new GIFT City office.

• Manage firewalls, VPN, leased lines, access control (with MFA) and separation between fund and broking teams.

• Support back-office, risk, reconciliation, email, user accounts and backups.

• Manage telecom, exchange, colocation and hardware vendors.

• Keep network diagrams, the asset inventory and DR drills current.

• As CISO, own the cybersecurity policy, VAPT and audits, incident response, regulatory reporting, and Board reporting on cyber risk.

**Qualifications**

• At least 3 years of hands-on network, systems or infrastructure work.

• Hands-on experience with routing and switching, firewalls, and Linux and Windows servers.

• Working knowledge of MFA, patching, logging, backups and incident response.

• Interest in financial markets and a basic understanding of order and market-data flow.

• Projects you can demonstrate.

• Able to work on site in GIFT City, Gandhinagar.

Good to have: experience at a broker, exchange member, prop firm, bank or fund; exposure to CME, SGX or FIX connectivity, market-data feeds or colocation; VAPT, cyber audits or regulatory cybersecurity frameworks; Python or Bash scripting; CCNA/CCNP, Fortinet NSE, Linux, CEH, CompTIA Security+ or ISO 27001.

How to apply: please apply through our careers page at tradeair.in/careers/it-infrastructure-engineer. Applications are reviewed only through the careers page.
